title: Segment Addition and Midpoints
seo_title: Segment Addition Postulate and Midpoints Worksheet (Geometry) | 100 Questions with Answers

meta_desc: Free Geometry worksheet on the Segment Addition Postulate and midpoints: lengths on a number line, algebra with x, and word problems. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: If B is between A and C, then AB + BC = AC.
key_sub: A midpoint splits a segment into two equal halves: AM = MB = AB ÷ 2.
body_html:
How it works

The length of a segment is the distance between its endpoints. On a number line, subtract the coordinates and take the absolute value: AB = |b − a|.

Segment Addition Postulate: if B is between A and C, then AB + BC = AC. The two parts add up to the whole.

The midpoint M of AB splits it into two congruent segments: AM = MB, and each is half of AB. With algebra, set the two halves equal and solve.

Example

B is between A and C. AB = 2x + 1, BC = 3x − 4 and AC = 32. Find BC.

(2x + 1) + (3x − 4) = 32

5x − 3 = 32, so x = 7

BC = 3(7) − 4 = 17

Answer: 17

Example

M is the midpoint of AB. AM = 4x − 3 and MB = 2x + 9. Find AB.

4x − 3 = 2x + 9, so x = 6

AM = 21, so AB = 2 × 21 = 42

Answer: 42

Common mistakes

  • Stopping at x. Read the question again: it often asks for a length.
  • Adding the two parts when the whole is given. Subtract to find the missing part.
  • Adding coordinates on a number line. Length is the difference, not the sum.
  • Forgetting to double. If M is the midpoint, AB = 2 × AM.

faq.q: What is the Segment Addition Postulate?
faq.a: If point B is between A and C on a segment, then AB + BC = AC. The lengths of the parts add up to the length of the whole segment.

faq.q: How do you find the midpoint on a number line?
faq.a: Add the two coordinates and divide by 2. It is the average of the endpoints.
A point, line, ray or segment that passes through the midpoint of a segment and splits it into two equal parts.

faq.q: How do you solve a midpoint problem with x?
faq.a: Set the two halves equal to each other, solve for x, then substitute to find the lengths. Double one half to get the whole segment.
